audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 read Pantheon while its why said the stage is even, and row 6 read Pantheon while its why said 'favouring you'.
audit.why: The packet chart gives Skill at level 1 and the mirror audit (pantheon__vladimir) already moved the two-item row to Vladimir. Pantheon is a flat-damage early champion who falls off; a 53.05% lane cannot end with him owning the last stage.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 6 flipped in phases[N].side and win[N] as one paired atomic group. Rows 1-5 already agreed with both the packet and their own whys and were left alone.

audit.why: Pantheon spikes at levels 2-5 and stays ahead into first item; Vladimir's is the two-item window. That is what the spikes already say.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry never states what Aegis Assault does, and the packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' with sequencingCues at 0.
audit.why: Shield Vault is a 600-range dash that stuns AND resets his auto, on 13s at rank 1 — the missing-interaction file flags exactly this wind-up tell. Comet Spear is 11s at rank 1. Aegis Assault, 22s at rank 1, makes him invulnerable to damage from the front while he strikes, so throwing Transfusion or Tides of Blood into his shield face is wasted damage. Vladimir's whole answer is 2 seconds of Sanguine Pool untargetability on a 28s rank-1 cooldown, and the mirror specifically asked for those numbers to be printed rather than 'the long cooldown'.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into spikes[0].text, phases[1].why and dosFull[0].d, and Aegis Assault's frontal invulnerability into spikes[0].text and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Pool after it' and 'when it is down' appeared with no duration anywhere on the page.
audit.why: 13s is short enough that 'wait it out' needs a number to be actionable, and 28s on Sanguine Pool is long enough that spending it wrong loses the lane.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and phases[1].why now carry the 13s figure.

edits.after: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for exactly that. Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1; step up only inside it.

edits.before: His all-in start. Pool after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A dash-stun and auto reset on 13s — pool it, then punish the next 13s.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front — walk behind him, or wait.

edits.before: Pantheon dominates here: Comet Spear (Q) poke plus a Shield Vault (W) stun sets up an all-in that beats your low early base damage, and pooling his W stun is your only reliable escape from the follow-up combo.
edits.after: Pantheon dominates here: Comet Spear (Q) on 11s pokes you out and Shield Vault (W) is a dash, a stun and an auto reset on 13s. Pool the vault, not the spear — and never trade into Aegis Assault's front, which blocks damage.
